BEGIN;

LOCK TABLE research.final_dataset_candidate IN SHARE MODE;

TRUNCATE TABLE research.final_dataset;

INSERT INTO research.final_dataset (
    research_id,
    university,
    title,
    authors,
    publication_year,
    publication_date,
    abstract,
    research_field,
    tech_category,
    journal,
    doi,
    url,
    source,
    has_doi,
    abstract_word_count
)
SELECT
    research_id,
    university,
    title,
    authors,
    publication_year,
    publication_date,
    abstract,
    research_field,
    tech_category,
    journal,
    doi,
    url,
    source,
    has_doi,
    abstract_word_count
FROM research.final_dataset_candidate;

COMMIT;
